candidate: camera-only linked carrier motion for temporarily occluded solo cargo
failure: At solo decision 285 the cyan cargo component is absent from TOP RGB and cargo-patch KLT has only two moving corners versus two stationary corners, below the existing three-point and 60-percent motion agreement gates.

design.prior_visual_link: While cargo motion is independently resolved from TOP RGB, link distributed orange carrier-chassis corners only when at least eight foreground corners within 25-120 px of prior cargo match the cargo motion within 1.5 px and constitute at least 60 percent of candidate corners.
design.occlusion: If the cargo silhouette and its direct RGB feature motion are unresolved, propagate its last visually established center only from bidirectionally tracked linked robot corners, requiring at least eight corners, 60-percent motion agreement, 20x15 px spatial spread, current orange foreground appearance, and a fresh own-RGB attachment check for the same observation.
design.limits: Retain existing cargo KLT three-point and 60-percent gates. At most three consecutive cargo-occluded frames are allowed; only a unique fresh cyan component restores direct cargo identity. A robot proxy cannot confirm final delivery or release. No command-history pose propagation, simulator state, changed camera/FOV, or weld is used.

current_own_rgb_attachment.method: compare_box_comotion on saved own RGB 284 to 285 with dispatch saturation calibration

saved_replay.scope: Saved-image control decision only; this is not a completed physical replay or measured cargo pose.

negative_checks: Missing, detached, mismatched, or stale own-RGB attachment evidence rejects the occlusion fallback.
A TOP image mixing stationary and moving carrier patches rejects carrier motion.
Replacing the carrier with static background rejects carrier appearance.
Repeating an occluded TOP image cannot silently regain direct cargo identity.
A proxy cargo center cannot confirm final slot containment.
saved_success_regressions: One accepted direct TOP RGB cargo-tracking transition each from native-v19-full (319 to 320), native-v25-full (283 to 284), and native-v26-full (284 to 285) retained the recorded cargo centers within 0.01 px.
